verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation, compliance and bookkeeping SaaS. Programmatic automation through an API is a fair question for such a service, but the evidence shows no documented headless, CLI or API-driven way to run it in CI. The only related item is a vague 'Advanced API integrations' pricing line, which appears to describe bookkeeping data integrations rather than automation of the product itself. Probes for llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
